How It Works

Two ways to get a basketball jersey with your identity on it — both start free.

01

Design it yourself in 3D

Open the free 3D designer, set your team's colors and layout on the basketball body, add your logo, and drop in a name and number for every player. Designing is always free.

02

Send us your concept

Have a reference, sketch, or AI render instead? Send it over. A $15 deposit puts a designer on it — first mockup in 24–48h, revisions until it's right. Credited in full to orders of 5+ jerseys, free for a team order.

03

We manufacture it

Full dye-sublimation on a polyester-elastane performance blend, with names, numbers and sponsors printed into the fabric. No minimum order. Delivered in the US in 25–30 days.

What's Included

A basketball jersey built the same way as every MOMUTO uniform — just on a different body.

Jersey & shorts

A matching jersey-and-shorts set, built and colored as one design so the set reads as a real uniform, not separate pieces.

Full dye-sublimation

The design is printed into the fabric, not sewn or heat-pressed on. It never peels, cracks or fades — and it allows unlimited colors, gradients and patterns at no extra cost.

Performance fabric

The same polyester-elastane performance blend as our soccer jerseys — breathable, durable, built for game speed.

Sizing & Roster

  • ✓ Per-player names and numbers, included in the print, no per-name charge
  • ✓ Mixed sizes across the roster are no problem — every player gets their own size in the same design
  • ✓ Order a single jersey or a full roster, from 1 to 100+ — no minimum order

Who It's For

Any team that wants a jersey with its own identity on it, not a blank template.

Rec leagues

Adult and co-ed rec league teams outfitting a roster with real names and numbers, without a bulk-order minimum.

Church & school leagues

Church leagues, school intramurals and after-school programs building a team look on a modest budget.

Corporate teams

Company sides and office leagues wanting branded jerseys for a tournament or a season.

Club & AAU-style teams

Club and travel teams that need consistent sizing and a full roster of names and numbers across every age group.

Where basketball is today: our finished, ready-to-wear basketball designs are in production and coming to the catalog. Right now, every basketball jersey is built by you in the free 3D designer or by our designers from your concept — there's no basketball catalog to browse yet, and we won't pretend otherwise.
“Basketball works exactly like soccer does for us: the same 3D tool, the same sublimation, the same no-minimum order. The only thing that changes is the body.”
— Alberto, founder of MOMUTO

Basketball Jersey FAQ

Do you make custom basketball jerseys, not just soccer?

Yes. Our free 3D designer now supports a basketball body, so you can design a custom basketball jersey the same way you'd design a soccer jersey — colors, logo, and per-player names and numbers. You can also send us your own concept and our designers will build it.

Is there a basketball design catalog yet?

Not yet — our finished, ready-to-wear basketball designs are in production and coming to the catalog. Today, every basketball jersey is either built in the free 3D designer or sent to us as a concept.

Is there a minimum order for custom basketball jerseys?

No. No minimum order, from a single jersey to a full roster. Pricing per jersey drops as the order grows.

Can every player have a different name and number?

Yes. Because every jersey is full dye-sublimation printed, names and numbers are printed into the fabric — a full roster of different names and numbers costs the same as one design, and mixed sizes across the roster are no problem.

How much does a custom basketball jersey cost and how long does it take?

From $25.90/jersey at 10+ ($45.90 single), the same pricing as our soccer jerseys. US delivery runs 25–30 days door to door, first mockup in 24–48 hours. Prefer our designers build your concept from scratch? That route starts with a $15 deposit, credited in full to orders of 5+ jerseys — free for a team order.
